llm_response.reason: The website displays several characteristics of a scam: (1) Promotes unrealistic bonuses/free gifts for new members solely for signing up, (2) Urgency tactics and manipulative language designed to psychologically pressure users ('promosi spesial', 'daftar hari ini dan dapatkan bonus gratis langsung'), (3) A huge, incoherent, and improbable range of product categories mirroring but not actually being Lazada, (4) Mentions of other gambling/slot-related brands ('slot PG'), (5) Confusing multilingual content, (6) Pushes users to download an app and register for bonuses, (7) Domain is newly registered with privacy protection, (8) Fake affiliations (using Lazada branding and categories but not actually being Lazada nor on their proper domain). These are clear scam website indicators, specifically in the fake online shopping category.
